text:
maria-g: Heads up — getting a handful of tickets from EU customers starting ~09:02 UTC complaining about streaming responses dropping mid-output and clients reconnecting in a tight loop. Customers see partial completions and then sudden end-of-stream.

ops-bot: Alert triggered: sse_stream_error_rate_eu increased 6x at 09:03 UTC. Top error codes: 502, 499 (client closed), and a rise in 401s for token refresh failures.

support_ana: Pasted one user's repro: long chat stream, at ~token 480 the client sees a final "data: [DONE]" without last chunk; client restarts and then gets a 401 on next open, loops. Customer claims this started after a deploy.

eng-ryan: @maria-g can you share request ids? Also rolling back recent proxy change is an option. Quick check: was there an nginx->envoy config change last deploy?

maria-g: request ids: req_eu_0a12, req_eu_0a15, req_eu_0a1f included in attached logs (excerpt):
```
2026-03-17T09:02:13.452Z req_eu_0a12 stream_chunk: frames=12 last_frame_size=512 status=ok
2026-03-17T09:02:13.621Z req_eu_0a12 sse_emit: write_error ECONNRESET
2026-03-17T09:02:13.622Z req_eu_0a12 upstream: 502 bad gateway
2026-03-17T09:02:13.625Z req_eu_0a12 client_reconnect: token_refresh_attempt=1 status=401
```

eng-ryan: ECONNRESET from upstream, followed by a 502 and then client-side token refresh failing with 401. That suggests client reconnects + stale token -> quick 401s. Could be that keepalive or heartbeat teardown is dropping TCP before KV cache flush?

sre-alex: I see increased SYN-ACK latency for the EU LB pool around 09:01:50-09:03:30. Also intermittent TLS handshake retrys. Might be overloaded frontends causing partial writes.

statusbot: Incident created: INC-20260317-32 "EU streaming partial outputs + reconnect loops". Notifying infra oncall.

support_ana: Affected customers report billing spikes when reconnect loops happen (repeated small sessions counted). They're asking for a mitigation ASAP.

eng-ryan: Mitigation proposal: 1) temporary route affected EU traffic to eu-west-2b fallback pool (no config changes to model), 2) enable server-side SSE keepalive pings at 20s to reduce client reconnection, 3) switch customer sessions to non-streaming fallback (blocking generation) for high-risk tenants, and 4) roll back recent proxy change if traffic doesn't stabilize.

maria-g: Any quick toggle to disable streaming for specific org ids? We can flip that for enterprise customers.

eng-ryan: Yes — config flag: org.<org_id>.streaming_enabled = false. I'll prepare canary for 2 tenants first.

sre-alex: I'm failing over 15% of traffic from EU pool to fallback pool now (manual routing). Monitoring metrics.

ops-bot: Routing change applied: eu-lb -> eu-fallback-2. Latency now down 30% on canary.

maria-g: Customer-facing update drafted: "We're aware of intermittent streaming interruptions in EU. We're routing traffic to alternate pool and will throttle streaming until full mitigation. No lost data; fallback to blocking endpoint recommended for uninterrupted response." Want sign-off.

support_ana: Send that now, mark affected orgs and offer one-off credits for excess billing while we investigate.

eng-ryan: Quick root-repro: emulate slow downstream (small bandwidth) + closed write mid-stream -> proxy returns ECONNRESET, client tries refresh and hits stale token window. Repro steps we used: 1) start stream with long response, 2) drop connection at ~70% of total bytes, 3) re-open with expired token -> observe 401 and loop. I'll add repro script to the ticket.

maria-g: Any clue if model fallback would help? Might still hit same proxy path.

eng-ryan: Fallback to smaller model reduces token volume but doesn't fix transport layer resets. This is a networking/proxy resilience issue + client token refresh pattern.

sre-alex: Short-term config change: increase upstream keepalive timeout from 15s -> 45s and bump TLS handshake concurrent limit to reduce handshake failures. Rolling to eu frontends in 5m.

statusbot: Change scheduled: increase_keepalive_eu applied to pool eu-frontends at 09:18 UTC.

ops-bot: Observability note: added a synthetic SSE check that will open a long stream and validate continuous chunks every 5s. Alert threshold: missing chunk for 15s -> page.

support_ana: Customer update posted at 09:25 UTC. Several customers confirmed improvement after routing change.

maria-g: Monitoring shows error-rate back down to baseline for canary orgs. Full rollback of proxy not needed.

eng-ryan: Next steps: 1) run thorough postmortem (include token refresh timing in client SDK), 2) update SDK to jitter token refresh to avoid tight reconnect-refresh loops, 3) include server keepalive pings in SSE by default, 4) billing dedupe: create a rule to de-duplicate short repeated sessions within 30s to avoid billing spikes.

sre-alex: I'll keep an eye on EU pool for 2 hours, then hand off.

maria-g: Marking incident as mitigated at 09:37 UTC. Will schedule follow-up postmortem and customer remediation (credits + opt-in polling fallback). Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

statusbot: Incident INC-20260317-32 status updated: mitigated -> monitoring. Postmortem requested.
